orchestrator.description: Primary orchestrator that auto-runs the 4-phase pipeline (plan, build, review, fix)

planner.description: Phase 1: Analyzes tasks and produces architecture plans

builder.description: Phase 2: Implements code from the architecture plan

reviewer.description: Phase 3: Audits code for security, architecture, and performance issues

fixer.description: Phase 4: Applies fixes from the review audit using CodeGraph
